name: COMB Behavioral Diagnosis
purpose: Turn user statements about a stuck goal or habit into a six-component COM-B profile (C-Ph, C-Ps, O-Ph, O-So, M-Re, M-Au), identify the binding constraint, and emit a hypothesis-status, user-correctable diagnosis.
triggers: user describes a stuck goal or habit
user asks why a behavior will not change
user requests a behavior-change plan without an existing diagnosis
TDF grid, MI conversation, or SDT check needs a component-level anchor
intervention selection needs a COM-B input
completion_conditions: six-component profile emitted with per-slot evidence quotes and salience
binding constraint identified or explicitly abstained on insufficient evidence
hypothesis label attached to profile and every slot
user has had the opportunity to correct any slot
representative_examples: "I keep meaning to walk after dinner but I always forget" → M-Au (habit/cue), binding constraint M-Au.
"I'd exercise but I genuinely don't know how to start" → C-Ps (knowledge), propose learning paths, do not answer for the user.
"There's no time between work and bed" → O-Ph (physical opportunity), surface schedule options; user keeps time-allocation judgment.
failure_hints: If every utterance codes to M-Re, run the anti-myopia sparring move.
If the profile reads as a verdict, downgrade to hypothesis.
If the user repeatedly corrects slots, the agent crossed the empowerment boundary; invoke Human_Empowerment_Boundary.

governance.rule: No AtomicOp executes on high-meaning tasks (identity, values, commitments, interpretive closure) without a Human_Empowerment_Boundary check first
